The replication reference date, full coauthor roster and original DOI are not printed. The report includes claim evaluations, outcomes, deviations, discussion, materials and references; it is an outcome report, not an abstract or preregistration. No PDF supplied. Both assigned records have null study/description and empty locators. Nine distinct claims (traces 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 13, 14) differ by regression specification, migration predictor and subgroup comparison. Nothing supplied distinguishes audit_id 2107 from 2108 or identifies either target claim. No assignment was made using row order or numerical matching. Printed coefficients are described as coefficients; standardisation is undocumented and no conversion to ser_method was attempted. Candidate coefficient/p evidence is retained below without row assignment. Complex claims 9, 13 and 14 do not print p in their result statements. No analytic sample count, exclusions or final group counts are provided in the supplied report. Age brackets describe eligibility, not sample counts. No N was derived or summed.
